## Caroline

**Identity & relationships:** Caroline is a transgender woman from Sweden (her home country), transitioning since about 2020. Friends, family and mentors—especially friends known for four years by June 2023—supported her transition; some friendships ended, but her remaining relationships feel more genuine. Caroline and Melanie are close friends and mutual supporters.

**Work/studies & goals:** She planned further education and is exploring counseling/mental-health work, particularly supporting trans people. Her own mental-health and transition experiences, counseling and support groups motivate her to create safe spaces. She mentors a transgender teen, joined a mentorship program, volunteers at an LGBTQ+ youth center, and belongs to Connected LGBTQ Activists. She advocates for LGBTQ+ rights, inclusion and acceptance.

Caroline has long dreamed of becoming a parent. She intends to adopt as a single parent, providing children without homes a safe, loving, supportive family. She researched agencies, applied in August 2023, passed agency interviews on **20 October 2023**, and is preparing with mentor support.

**Creative life & interests:** Caroline has made art since about age 17. Painting, drawing, abstract art, stained glass and guitar (acoustic guitar since about 2018) help her express emotions, explore gender identity and feel empowered. She enjoys flowers, nature, reading and piano (learning in July 2023); favorite color: blue. Favorite book: *Becoming Nicole*. She planned LGBTQ+ art shows for August/September 2023 and plays “Brave” by Sara Bareilles. She loves horses and rode with her father as a child.

**Possessions/pets:** A cross-and-heart necklace from her Swedish grandmother; a friend-made bowl received for her 18th birthday; a library for future children; guinea pig Oscar, who likes parsley.

**Timeline:** **7 May 2023**, LGBTQ+ support group; **23 June**, counseling workshop; **27 June**, discussed treasured necklace and bowl; **10 July**, LGBTQ conference; **14 July**, adoption council meeting; **July–August**, mentoring, activism, volunteering and art projects; **11 August**, Pride parade; **6 October**, transgender poetry reading; **20 October**, passed adoption interviews.

## Melanie

**Identity & family:** Melanie is married and has children; she had been married five years by **9 June 2023** (wedding approximately 2018). Her husband and children are her main motivation, support and source of love. She values family outings, camping, beaches, museums, parks, hiking and nature. A son’s accident during an October 2023 road trip frightened the family, but he was okay.

**Work/studies:** She was balancing work and childcare in May 2023. She volunteered with family at a homeless shelter on **24 August 2023** and ran a mental-health charity race on **20 May**.

**Hobbies & values:** Melanie paints landscapes, still lifes, animals and sunsets; plays pottery and clarinet; runs, reads, swims, enjoys live music and family painting. Art—especially pottery—is therapeutic, calming and central to her life. She likes flowers, classical music (Bach, Mozart), Ed Sheeran’s “Perfect,” and *Charlotte’s Web*. She values self-care, creativity, mental health, compassion, family time and connection with nature. She is considering adoption after a friend adopted in 2022.

**Pets/possessions:** Dog and cat Luna and Oliver (names not matched to species); later pets Bailey and Oliver are mentioned. She bought two wooden family-love figurines on **21 October 2023**.

**Timeline:** **2022**, painted a special lake sunrise and watched the Perseid meteor shower while camping; **June–July 2023**, camping, swimming, museum and pottery outings; **13 August**, daughter’s birthday at a Matt Patterson concert; **September**, injury interrupted pottery; **14–15 October**, family road trip and Grand Canyon visit; **19 October**, trail outing with children.
